method.build: Fresh npm run build:arcade output (dist-arcade), exercised in the Arcade CSP sandbox harness; standalone production build was also rebuilt

designConformance.designClaim: Pointer drag steers, release drops the nearest pending letter, and an unmoved tap shorter than 180ms spends one of up to three gust charges before drop, pushing nearby hazards and briefly protecting the hull; keyboard steering, drop, gust, pause, and mute controls are also provided.
designConformance.observed: The production runtime maps the pointer into the 390×844 design space, steers toward held pointer/keyboard targets, branches pointer-up at 180ms with short tap taking the gust path, spends a charge, grants 0.7s protection and displaces hazards within 130px. Space, Shift, arrows/WASD, P, and M are bound as specified, and the intro/HUD presents the same controls.

designConformance.designClaim: Altitude starts at 76, drains by 2.8 per second outside lift, restores by 22 per second in lift, is shown in an ALT bar, and at zero costs one of four hull points before resetting to 28; another altitude impact is armed only after altitude exceeds 35.
designConformance.observed: The runtime initializes altitude 76 and hull 4, applies the tested altitudeAfter rates and 0–100 bounds, renders the ALT value/bar with a low-altitude warning, applies a hull hit at zero, resets altitude to 28, and re-arms only above 35.

designConformance.designClaim: Remaining in an updraft restores altitude and charges gust storage up to three, with one gust available at departure.
designConformance.observed: A circular lift check drives both altitude recovery and a 2.5-second charge accumulator; each completed charge adds a gust up to three, while initial and restarted runs begin with one.

designConformance.designClaim: Birds and active lightning clouds damage the hull by one, grant 1.2 seconds of invulnerability, and wet the first undelivered dry letter; lightning cycles through a 1-second warning, 0.65-second active interval, then cooldown.
designConformance.observed: Collision uses hazard and 17px ship radii, gates cloud damage to lightningPhase(active), subtracts one hull, sets 1.2s invulnerability, resets combo and applies wetFirstPending. The phase helper and renderer implement warning below 1.0s, active through 1.65s, and cooldown for the remainder of the four-second cycle.

designConformance.designClaim: A matching mailbox drop succeeds within 42px and is precise within 20px; it awards 1,000 base, 400 precise, 250 dry, multiplied by the ×1.0/×1.5/×2.0 success chain, while a miss resets the chain.
designConformance.observed: Drop selects the nearest undelivered letter/island pair, rejects distance over 42, calls the tested deliveryScore calculation, advances combo to a maximum of two steps, and resets combo on a miss. HUD and delivery messages expose score and multiplier.

designConformance.designClaim: The gold urgent contract adds 900 points when delivered before the last slot and 500 when delivered last.
designConformance.observed: Gold delivery checks the count already delivered and adds 900 when fewer than two are complete, otherwise 500 when it is the third delivery.

designConformance.designClaim: The storm gate remains locked until all three differently colored contracts are delivered; flying through it ends in return, while zero hull or the six-minute limit ends in distress.
designConformance.observed: The tested gate predicate requires exactly three delivered letters. The runtime renders locked/open gate states, finishes successfully only after that predicate and entering the top gate area, and finishes unsuccessfully at hull zero or 360 elapsed seconds.

designConformance.designClaim: Final score adds 8 points per whole remaining second and 250 per remaining hull point; successful grades are S at 5,200, A at 4,200, B at 3,000, otherwise C, distress is D, and GameResult.phase is the delivered count from zero to three.
designConformance.observed: The tested finalScore and grade helpers implement the stated bonuses and thresholds. finish sends the computed total and the filtered delivered-letter count to the host and renders the grade, score, delivery count, and hull in the result panel.

designConformance.designClaim: The seed drives three differently colored island positions, lift position, and hazards; a 76px-wide vertical corridor joining the lift is kept clear of the full hazard collision shapes plus the ship's 17px radius during placement and movement.
designConformance.observed: Production route generation uses the seeded logic RNG for islands, lift and hazard placement. placeOutsideCorridor enforces half-width 38 + hazard radius + ship radius 17 initially and after every hazard movement step, reflecting horizontal velocity at the boundary. The creator test rechecked this invariant over 200 seeds, both hazard kinds, 30 hazards and 120 movement steps each.

designConformance.designClaim: Cloud layers scroll to convey forward travel, hazards flow downward and recycle above the screen, birds cross horizontally, and rain, lightning, feathers/weather forms are composed in procedural Canvas 2D.
designConformance.observed: The rebuilt production canvas showed animated scrolling cloud layers, rain, islands, lift, gate, ship and hazards. Runtime updates move hazards downward and recycle them at the top, give seeded horizontal velocity to bird/cloud hazards, and draw bird flocks and phased lightning procedurally.

designConformance.designClaim: Each 1,000 final-score points awards one locally accumulated stamp, unlocking bright hull at four, teal sail at nine, and a gold gust ring at fifteen without changing performance; storage-denied sandboxes retain the current-run total.
designConformance.observed: The tested stampReward/cosmeticTier helpers implement floor(score/1000) and thresholds 4/9/15. The runtime reads and writes the prefixed local total inside try/catch, keeps its in-memory total if writes fail, and drawShip changes only fill/stroke appearance by tier.

designConformance.designClaim: Korean and English provide the same game rule and state information; document deactivation pauses automatically; WebAudio starts only after first user input and supplies wind, sail, gust, hit, delivery and gate sounds, with supported haptics used briefly.
designConformance.observed: Fresh viewport runs reached the result UI in Korean and English with no errors or clipping, while the canvas tables contain parallel control, status and result strings. visibilitychange pauses active play. AudioContext creation occurs only from pointer/keyboard unlock paths; wind panning and all specified event tones are wired, P/background/result suspend audio, M mutes, destroy closes it, and gameplay events call navigator.vibrate optionally.

designConformance.designClaim: The game uses a 390×844 portrait Canvas 2D design and remains playable inside a uniformly letterboxed Arcade frame.
designConformance.observed: Fresh viewport verification measured the standalone canvas at exactly 390×844 CSS pixels with a 1560×3376 backing store at DPR 3. The Arcade-shaped 390×844 viewport produced a uniform 358.578125×776 canvas, remained fully inside the frame, had no page overflow or console/page errors, and the CSP harness mounted the release canvas at 390×844 with all required styles and assets.

creatorTests.covers: Creator-selected delivery radius and scoring, wet-letter order, gate predicate, final bonus and grade boundaries, seeded route bounds, lightning timing, stamp/cosmetic thresholds, altitude rates, full collision-shape corridor clearance, deterministic logic RNG, records, and locale key parity.
TypeScript validation and standalone production bundle generation.
Arcade TypeScript/bundle generation, immutable release manifest creation, hashes, declared fonts, entry module and release budget verification.
Actual Arcade-style sandbox/CSP boot, stylesheet application, canvas layout, required asset responses, and absence of CSP, console, and page errors.
390×844 plus supported compact, large-phone and wide standalone/portal layouts, DPR backing store, uniform aspect, page overflow, and Korean/English game-over bounds.
Current sequence deployment-only page mount and absence of console/page errors with seed 17.

deployable.observed: Fresh standalone and Arcade production builds succeeded. The Arcade verifier accepted 5 immutable files totaling 1,618,633 bytes with 92,912 bytes of gzipped JavaScript; entry.mjs, stylesheet and all three declared Galmuri font assets were present and hashed. Arcade CSP execution loaded the stylesheet, laid out the 390×844 canvas, returned all requested assets, and recorded zero missing assets, CSP violations, console errors, or page errors. Deployment smoke mounted successfully with sourceHash 5528e1f6047d993038ca4461cc16413f0c06117ea353946c247656624acbd027.

notes: Review was performed independently from the final GDD, source, fresh production/Arcade builds, creator tests, and runtime verification; the pre-existing design-review.json was not used as evidence.

Device-specific haptic strength, perceived audio mix, long-session balance, dependency audit findings, and Toss-container behavior are outside this design-conformance/deployability verdict and remain documented in DAY.md.

summary.ko: 최종 GDD의 구체적 플레이·결과 약속이 현재 소스 해시의 프로덕션/아케이드 빌드에 구현되어 있다. 제작자 테스트 30개와 빌드, 불변 릴리스, CSP, 390×844 포함 뷰포트, deployment-only 스모크가 모두 통과해 출고 가능으로 판정한다.
summary.en: The current-source production and Arcade builds implement every concrete play and outcome promise in the final GDD. All 30 creator tests, both builds, immutable release verification, CSP execution, viewport checks including 390×844, and deployment-only smoke passed, so the build is cleared for release.
